attributes.residual: NAMED MECHANISM, and the prior record's framing is CORRECTED in a way that matters for anyone who picks this up. The residual is NOT 'a masked shift'. Every source form falls into exactly one of two classes, and which class you land in is decided by ONE thing: whether MWCC gives the bit-insert's destination a register DISTINCT from the loaded byte's. CLASS A (244/244 instruction parity, 1 differing word @0x228, axes 2/3/8): our word is a MASK-FORM copy (`rlwinm rD,rS,...`, either the explicit `& ~0x100` of the canonical idiom or the u16 read truncation) where the target has the plain copy `addi r18,r19,0`; the rlwimi and the unmasked `slwi r17,r18,3` both MATCH. CLASS B (243/244, axes 6/7/9/10): MWCC coalesces the destination with the loaded byte, emits the rlwimi in place, the shift is unmasked, and OUR STREAM IS IDENTICAL TO THE TARGET EXCEPT THAT THE TARGET CARRIES ONE EXTRA, SEMANTICALLY REDUNDANT `addi r18,r19,0` -- ours-only is literally NONE. The whole remaining gap is therefore a single redundant register-to-register copy that the retail allocator emitted and ours elides, which is the mr/addi-family decision that claim.law.live-zero-copy-vs-remat-is-allocator-not-source and the LZ census jointly establish is not a source property in either direction. WEBFRANK IS RULED OUT BY PRECONDITION, not by guess: class B is instruction-count-asymmetric and no stage inserts a word; class A has parity but our word is `rlwinm`, which decodes as no sanctioned copy form, so `equivalent_copy_form` refuses in both its `unconditional` and `dominating_def` modes. DO-NOT-RETRY, all measured here: declared width of idx (u8 vs u32), presence/absence of the val variable, statement-split vs single-expression vs fully-inlined OR, the canonical `(x & ~M) | (b << k)` idiom, declaration placement (inner block vs enclosing block), and OR operand order. What is NOT excluded and is the only honest next move: a lever that raises register pressure or lengthens the loaded byte's live range across the insert so MWCC is forced to allocate a distinct destination -- no natural source form in this loop does that, since the byte is dead immediately after the insert in both streams.
